
# A constructor that stores a function in a field is rejected when a function of the object could apply it to a value that reaches the object again, through a datatype, a tuple, the constants of another object, a newtype, or a generic class or trait; the old check looked only at the function's type and its type arguments, so false was provable (https://github.com/erniecohen/dafny/issues/453).
git-issues/github-issue-453.dfy
